options: To the staff member handling the return.
To the original payment method.
Into store credit in every case.
To whichever card the gift recipient brings.

RETURNS DESK
Unused items may be returned within 14 days with proof of purchase. Items reduced because of a clearly labeled cosmetic mark may be returned only if a different fault is found.
